data.name: Thomasa
data.gender_notes: Thomasa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Thomas, meaning 'twin' or 'companion'. In the New Testament, Thomas was one of the twelve apostles, known as 'Doubting Thomas' for his disbelief in the resurrection of Jesus. The name Thomasa carries the meaning “Twin, Companion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thomasa usually hope their child will grow to embody twin, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Thomasa belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Twin, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thomasa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: תומסא
in_hebrew.meaning: תומסא היא שמה הנשי של תומאס, נגזר מטאום התאומים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: תומסא היא הצורה הנשית של השם תומאס, שמקורו בארמית תאומה, התאומים. השם תומאס הוא אחד משנים עשר השליחים של ישוע המשיח, והוא ידוע באמונתו הנלהבת בישוע. השם תומסא משמש נשים נוצריות רבות, והוא מייצג אמונה ותקווה

in_greek.name: Θωμάσα
in_greek.meaning: Θωμάσα σημαίνει δίδυμος, αναφερόμενος στην πνευματική σύνδεση με τον Απόστολο Θωμάς
in_greek.long_meaning: Θωμάσα είναι η θηλυκή μορφή του ονόματος Θωμάς, που προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για δίδυμος. Ο Απόστολος Θωμάς ήταν ένας από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού και ήταν γνωστός για την αμφισβήτησή του και την επακόλουθη πίστη. Το όνομα Θωμάσα χρησιμοποιείται από πολλές χριστιανές γυναίκες και συμβολίζει την πνευματική σύνδεση με τον Απόστολο Θωμάς

in_latin.name: Thomasa
in_latin.meaning: Thomasa significat gemellus, referens ad spiritualem connexionem cum Apostolo Thoma
in_latin.long_meaning: Thomasa est forma feminina nominis Thoma, quod derivatur ex aramaeo vocabulo pro gemello. Apostolus Thomas fuit unus ex duodecim apostolis Iesu Christi et notus fuit propter suam incredulitatem et subsequentem fidem. Nomen Thomasa a multis christianis mulieribus usurpatur et spiritualem connexionem cum Apostolo Thoma repraesentat

in_english.long_meaning: Thomasa is the feminine form of Thomas, derived from the Aramaic word for twin. The name Thomasa is used by many Christian women, representing spiritual connection to Apostle Thomas, signifying faith, hope, and devotion. Historically, the name has been associated with loyalty and conviction, reflecting the apostle's journey. Today, Thomasa remains a meaningful name in Christian tradition, symbolizing a strong spiritual bond
